en-US.building.crystallizer.title: Crystallizer
en-US.building.dissolver.title: Dissolver
en-US.building.crystal-group.title: Crystal Expansion
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_Crystallizer.title: Crystallizer
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_Crystallizer.text: Processes <gl>Shapes</gl> by coating corresponding <gl>Parts</gl> with <gl>Unstable Fluid</gl>, transforming them into <gl>Crystal</gl>.
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_Dissolver.title: Dissolver
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_Dissolver.text: Dissolve the <gl>shape</gl>, producing an <gl>unstable fluid</gl> carrying <gl>part type</gl> and <gl>color</gl>.
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_UnstableFluid.title: Unstable Fluid
en-US.wiki.WKFluids_UnstableFluid.text: A special <gl>fluid</gl> that carries both <gl>part type</gl> and <gl>color</gl>. Produced by the <gl>dissolver</gl>, it is consumed by the <gl>crystal generator</gl> and <gl>crystallizer</gl> to produce corresponding <gl>crystals</gl>.

zh-Hans.building.crystallizer.title: 晶化器
zh-Hans.building.crystallizer.description: 将<gl>不稳定流体 覆盖</gl>在对应的<gl>部件</gl>上并将其<gl>晶化</gl>。
zh-Hans.building.dissolver.title: 溶解器
zh-Hans.building.dissolver.description: 溶解<gl>形状</gl>并产出<gl>不稳定流体</gl>。
zh-Hans.building.crystal-group.title: 晶体扩展
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_Crystallizer.title: 晶化器
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_Crystallizer.text: 用<gl>不稳定流体</gl>覆盖对应<gl>部件</gl>，将其转化为<gl>晶体</gl>。
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_Dissolver.title: 溶解器
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_Dissolver.text: 溶解<gl>形状</gl>，产出携带<gl>部件类型</gl>和<gl>颜色</gl>的<gl>不稳定流体</gl>。
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_UnstableFluid.title: 不稳定流体
zh-Hans.wiki.WKFluids_UnstableFluid.text: 一种特殊的<gl>流体</gl>，同时携带<gl>部件类型</gl>和<gl>颜色</gl>。由<gl>溶解器</gl>产出，被<gl>晶体生成器</gl>和<gl>晶化器</gl>消耗产生对应<gl>晶体</gl>。
